test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Arthur has some strange ideas, but on this occasion, I am __inclined__ to agree with him.
solution:
The correct answer is "**tended.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Inclined" means wanting to behave in a particular way**.

 
 
• Example: If you are so inclined, you can watch TV.
 
 
 
• **"Tended" means to have a tendency or inclination towards something**, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
 
• ​Example: She tended to monopolize the conversation.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "inclined to agree" means that the speaker is leaning towards agreeing with Arthur.
 
• Thus, the word "tended" is the synonym of the word "inclined."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 **(conflicted)** means to be in disagreement with oneself, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3 **(refused)** means to decline or reject something, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 4 **(conspired)** means to plan or plot secretly, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
